raw:
The user wants UI onboarding text for a Traditional Chinese accounting/expense-tracking app. Three onboarding pages:

1. Connect bank accounts to auto-import transactions
2. Auto-categorize expenses
3. Monthly budget reminders

Last page has a "Get started" CTA button.

Output only JSON: {"t1":"...","b1":"...","t2":"...","b2":"...","t3":"...","b3":"...","cta":"..."}

Rules:
- No chatty phrasing for buttons, titles, status
- No casual versions of cancel/complete
- No apologies, exclamation marks, emojis in errors
- No questions as buttons/titles
- No explaining how numbers are computed, no disclaimers
- No describing unseen things, no containers/utensils/background/lighting (irrelevant here)
- No "約" when numbers are estimates (no numbers here anyway)
- No "我們"; avoid "你的/您的" unless needed to distinguish whose data
- Don't repeat what the title says; don't explain the obvious
- No mainland Chinese terms: 當前、默認、設置、數據、視頻、用戶、緩存、軟件、網絡、信息
- No periods at end of labels/buttons
- Keep it short

Titles should be short. Subtitles should add value, not repeat the title.

Page 1: Title: 連結銀行帳戶. Subtitle: 交易自動匯入 or 匯入交易記錄... but "自動匯入交易" — the title says 連結銀行帳戶, subtitle can say 交易自動匯入,免手動輸入. Hmm "免手動輸入" adds info. Keep concise.

Let me draft:

t1: 連結銀行帳戶
b1: 交易自動匯入,免手動記錄

Actually, avoid repeating. Title: 連結銀行帳戶. Subtitle: 交易自動匯入. That's fine—title says connect bank accounts, subtitle says transactions auto-import. Not repeating.

t2: 自動分類支出
b2: hmm need something that doesn't repeat. Could say: 每筆交易歸入適當類別? That repeats 分類. Maybe: 匯入的交易即時歸類 — repeats. Perhaps focus on benefit: "掌握各類別花費" or "一看就知道錢花在哪". "錢花在哪" is a bit chatty/question-like. Better: 「掌握各類支出比例」 — but that repeats 支出. Rules say don't repeat title already said. Title: 自動分類支出. Subtitle could be: 「交易依類別歸位」? Hmm.

Maybe restructure titles vs subtitles:

t1: 連結銀行帳戶
b1: 交易自動匯入

t2: 支出自動分類
b2: 免手動整理? Or 「每筆交易歸入對應類別」 repeats. Could emphasize benefit: 「隨時查看各類別花費」.

t3: 每月預算提醒
b3: 接近上限時通知 — that repeats 提醒 concept but adds specifics. Or 「超過預算時即時通知」— 提醒 vs 通知 similar. Maybe b3: 「掌握每月花費進度」.

Hmm, let me think about what natural onboarding copy is like:

t1: 連結銀行帳戶
b1: 交易自動匯入,不必手動輸入

But rule: 不要寫超過必要的長度 — keep short. Also no commas issues. Maybe:

b1: 自動匯入每筆交易 — repeats? Title 連結銀行帳戶, subtitle 自動匯入交易 — no repetition.

t2: 支出自動分類
b2: 每筆交易歸入對應類別 — this explains how, kind of repeats 分類. Alternative: 「花費一目了然」... "一目了然" fine. Or 「掌握各類別花費」.

Actually maybe swap: title is the feature, subtitle is the benefit.

t1: 連結銀行帳戶
b1: 交易自動匯入,免手動記錄

t2: 支出自動分類
b2: 掌握各類別花費

t3: 預算提醒
b3: 每月掌握花費進度 — hmm 掌握 repeated from b2. Change.

b2: 快速掌握花費分布
b3: 預算接近上限時通知

But t3 given as "每月預算提醒" per prompt. The user said third page: 每月預算提醒. So:

t3: 每月預算提醒
b3: 接近上限時通知

Hmm "接近上限" — introduces an unseen thing? It's describing feature behavior, acceptable. Or 「設定上限,超過時通知」. Keep simple:

t3: 每月預算提醒
b3: 花費接近預算時通知 — repeats 提醒/預算. Maybe b3: 「不超過每月上限」? That's instructions-y.

Let me think about what adds value without repeating:

Page 3 title: 每月預算提醒. Subtitle: could be about peace of mind: 「掌控每月餘額」? Or 「月底前調整花費」.

Maybe subtitles should be benefits:

t1: 連結銀行帳戶
b1: 交易自動匯入,免於手動輸入

Hmm "免於" awkward. 「不必再手動輸入」

Length: keep short.

Final draft:

b1: 交易自動匯入,免手動輸入

t2: 支出自動分類
b2: 掌握各類別花費

t3: 每月預算提醒

cta: 開始使用

Check rules:
- No 我们 ✓
- No 你的/您的 ✓
- No question titles ✓
- No exclamation ✓
- No periods at end ✓ (b1, b2, b3 no ending punctuation; b1 has comma mid-sentence, fine)
- No mainland terms ✓ (匯入, 類別, 通知, 花費 all Taiwan-friendly)
- 不重複標題: t1/b1 fine; t2 支出自動分類 / b2 掌握各類別花費 — "類別" echoes 分類 slightly but adds benefit; acceptable. t3 每月預算提醒 / b3 花費接近上限時通知 — 通知 echoes 提醒; hmm. Maybe b3: 「月底前掌控花費進度」? Or b3: 「預算即將用完時通知」 repeats 預算.

Alternative t3/b3 split: t3: 每月預算提醒, b3: 掌握花費進度. Then b2 needs different: b2: 各類別自動歸位? Hmm.

Check: 一目了然 — not chatty. 掌握 fine. No mainland words. "當月" — rule bans 當前, not 當月. Fine.

b1: "免手動輸入" — good, adds value. Or just "交易自動匯入" alone, shorter. Rule says don't write longer than necessary. "交易自動匯入" is enough. But subtitle with just that might be too bare; it's fine. Actually comma version adds a benefit. Keep "交易自動匯入,免手動輸入"? Slight redundancy: 匯入 implies 免手動輸入. So just "交易自動匯入". Hmm, but a single 6-char subtitle is fine.

b2: 花費分布一目了然

Hmm b2 "花費分布一目了然" and b3 "掌握當月花費進度" both mention 花費. Vary: b2: "各類別花費一目了然"? Still 花費. b2: "掌握各類支出"? repeats 支出 from t2. 

Options:
- t2: 自動分類支出, b2: 花費分布一目了然
- t3: 每月預算提醒, b3: 超過預算前即時通知 — repeats 預算. b3: 接近上限時通知.

"接近上限時通知" — does it explain how numbers computed? No. Fine. Is 通知 vs 提醒 repetition? It elaborates: when reminded. Acceptable and adds timing info.

But wait: t2 title given by user is 「自動分類支出」. Fine.
